analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($696.20) vs SMA5 ($699.12)/SMA20 ($703.50)/SMA50 ($697.72): indicating short-to-mid term trend below moving averages.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($687.41)/SMA200 ($655.26): maintaining mid-to-long term trend above moving averages.
· 52-week position (85.4%) + current price level near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (51.4 → 44.4): entering oversold territory, continuing downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.7708 → -1.5536): bearish momentum continues, worsening after a death cross.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band $696.05): approaching lower band, narrowing band width.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($679.73): based on 200-day moving average.
· Swing resistance ($699.15): based on 5-day moving average, potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: sideways range, no clear trend formation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.12x): normal level, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to RSI entering oversold and ADX showing no trend.
